description: This header file 'reachable.h' declares functions and structures related to traversing and marking reachable objects within a Git-like version control system.

methods.name: add_unseen_recent_objects_to_traversal
methods.description: Adds unseen recent objects to the traversal, calling a callback function for each object.

methods.name: mark_reachable_objects
methods.description: Marks objects as reachable based on traversal parameters.

ctags.name: report_recent_object_fn
ctags.pattern: /^typedef void report_recent_object_fn(const struct object *, struct packed_git *,$/
